records.part: PAWS (Pedestrian Audible Warning System) control equipment at pedestrian crossings
records.reason: The existing PAWS control equipment has become technologically obsolete, making spare parts difficult or impossible to obtain, and thereby compromising the system's reliability and maintenance viability.
records.installed_location: San Clemente Beach Trail pedestrian crossings (Dije, El Portal, Corto, T-Street, Lost Winds, Calafia) and San Clemente Pier crossing, MP 203.9-206.0, Orange Subdivision
